title: Fully open short
pitch: A short made only from permissively licensed weights: Klein, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step.
why: The whole chain is commercial-friendly by licence, with no revenue caps or territory terms: the clean baseline for anything you want to sell.

fields.label: The world
fields.default: a jungle temple at dawn, gold light through mist

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5
models.licence: MIT (checked on the ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 model page)

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Wan 2.2 5B runs in less memory than H3 or LTX.

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Still 1
raw_steps.prompt: Wide cinematic still of {world}, overgrown stone stairs. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Still 2
raw_steps.prompt: Close cinematic still of a carved stone face covered in moss in {world}. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Move 1
raw_steps.prompt: Mist drifts across the stairs and the camera glides forward slowly.

raw_steps.label: Move 2
raw_steps.prompt: Light slides across the stone and leaves fall slowly.
